newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures finish strong.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures finish strong.

text.p: U.S. stock index futures finished higher, recovering from early strong economic data that sparked a weak Treasury bond tone.

In afternoon trading December S&Ps managed to shrug off early weakness tied to bond losses and hovered in positive territory. Traders said short-covering and a flurry of buy-stops drove the rally, and an underlying bullish tone buoyed the contract into the close.
December pushed to a session high at 690.55 and posted an outside day with a higher close on daily bar charts, a potentially bullish signal, chartists said.

December S&Ps had challenged the 695.00 contract high on Monday but fell short of that level, consolidating below there since then. Traders said another stab at the contract high could put December on track for bullish targets in the low 700.00 zone.

"The market's strong and it's ignoring the bond weakness for now," an S&P 500 futures trader said. "We're rangebound but there's an upward bias here. We may sit here for a few days because we've lost a little momentum, but it's an upside bias," he said.
Traders noted that stock indices shook off bond weakness. Bond languished most of the session after strong housing data and weaker than expected jobless claims battered the market.
U.S. August housing starts rose 4.5 percent to a 1.525 million annual rate, the highest since March 1994. The latest weekly jobless claims fell to 329,000 from a revised 331,000 the previous week.

December S&Ps gleaned brief strength in the morning from the latest Philadelphia Federal Reserve Bank survey. The business outlook index fell to 13.9 in September from 21.5 in August. The prices paid index jumped to 18.0 from 4.6.
September S&P 500 futures expired firm at the close, up 2.85 points to 684.05. September will settle at Friday's opening price. S&P 500 and S&P 100 cash index options expire on Friday.

December S&P 500 finished up 2.65 points to 689.85, Value Lines rose 1.35 to 637.35, Midcap 400s rose 0.90 to 240.55, NYSE Composite rose 0.75 points to 366.75, and Nikkei 225 rose 170.0 to 21,285.0. --Derivatives Desk 312-408-8750 E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
